name: vibe-chip-spec
title: Vibe chip · every count
note: The rule in one table: chip, segment and legend for 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 to 15 and all 16 picks.

name: vibe-3-320
title: Vibe chip · 320px, 3 vibes
note: Three dots and "3 vibes". The legend names all three under it.

name: vibe-4-320
title: Vibe chip · 320px, 4 vibes
note: The stack stays at three dots; "4 vibes". The legend names four, wrapping to two lines at most.

name: vibe-all-320
title: Vibe chip · 320px, all vibes
note: Every bucket picked: "All vibes", three dots, no legend names (the chip says it).

name: vibe-crowded-320
title: Vibe chip · 320px, beside every filter
note: When, Where, Price and Vibe on: the row runs off the right edge and scrolls sideways. It never wraps.

name: vibe-3-360
title: Vibe chip · 360px, 3 vibes
note: Three dots and "3 vibes". The legend names all three under it.

name: vibe-4-360
title: Vibe chip · 360px, 4 vibes
note: The stack stays at three dots; "4 vibes". The legend names four, wrapping to two lines at most.

name: vibe-all-360
title: Vibe chip · 360px, all vibes
note: Every bucket picked: "All vibes", three dots, no legend names (the chip says it).

name: vibe-crowded-360
title: Vibe chip · 360px, beside every filter
note: When, Where, Price and Vibe on: the row runs off the right edge and scrolls sideways. It never wraps.

name: vibe-crowded-320-scrolled
title: Vibe chip · 320px, row scrolled to the end
note: The same row scrolled: the Vibe chip, last in bar order, sits whole at the right with the 16px gutter.

name: vibe-3-d
title: Vibe segment · desktop, 3 vibes
note: Three dots, "Electronic +2", as "+1" is drawn today. The legend names all three.

name: vibe-4-d
title: Vibe segment · desktop, 4 vibes, every segment on
note: "Electronic +3" in a full bar: the segment keeps its share and ellipsises the name, never the "+3".

name: vibe-all-d
title: Vibe segment · desktop, all vibes
note: "All vibes", three dots, no suffix and no legend names.
